items.title: Lou Marini interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 15, 2023
items.q: the other tenor player is a guy named Matt Hong who went to North Texas and he’s in his 40s, and he’s a monster. So, and during the course of rehearsing with this band I had... you’re always having to hire subs

ctx.x: The same thing happened to me, and they come in as freshmen and I go hmmm, I’m going to have to up my game here.

Well I feel that all the time. During the pandemic I had a burst of creativity and I recorded — I mean I wrote 13 new big band compositions and in February I recorded them with a big band that I’ve been rehearsing. And there are, in the saxophone section, the baritone player is Dave Rickenberg. He plays his ass off. He’s in his 50s I suppose. There’s two young saxophone players, an alto player named Andrew Gold and a tenor player named Sam Dillon, and they are monsters. And Lawrence Waldron is the lead alto…
just in the saxophone section we heard like a dozen young saxophone players all of whom just make you want to jump in the practice room and try to — yeah.
